verdict.rationale: Orama's official embeddings plugin generates embeddings for documents at insert time and for queries at search time, so developers can run vector and hybrid search without building their own embedding pipeline (orama-docs-7, with vector/hybrid search context in orama-docs-4 and orama-docs-5). The evidence is a single thin doc mention, however. Missing for 10: details on supported embedding models and configuration, explicit evidence of managed embedding in Orama Cloud, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
